warehouse.sql: SELECT w_id,w_ytd FROM warehouse ORDER BY w_id

district.sql: SELECT d_w_id,d_id,d_ytd,d_next_o_id FROM district WHERE d_id IN(7,7) ORDER BY d_w_id,d_id

customer.sql: SELECT c_w_id,c_d_id,c_id,c_balance,c_ytd_payment,c_payment_cnt,c_data FROM customer WHERE c_d_id=7 ORDER BY c_w_id,c_d_id,c_id

stock.sql: SELECT s_w_id,s_i_id,s_quantity,s_ytd,s_order_cnt,s_remote_cnt FROM stock WHERE 1=0 ORDER BY s_w_id,s_i_id

orders.sql: SELECT o_w_id,o_d_id,o_id,o_c_id,COALESCE(o_carrier_id,0),o_ol_cnt,o_all_local FROM orders WHERE o_d_id=7 AND o_id>=3001 ORDER BY o_w_id,o_d_id,o_id

new_order.sql: SELECT no_w_id,no_d_id,no_o_id FROM new_order WHERE no_d_id=7 AND no_o_id>=3001 ORDER BY no_w_id,no_d_id,no_o_id

order_line.sql: SELECT ol_w_id,ol_d_id,ol_o_id,ol_number,ol_i_id,ol_supply_w_id,ol_quantity,ol_amount,ol_dist_info FROM order_line WHERE ol_d_id=7 AND ol_o_id>=3001 ORDER BY ol_w_id,ol_d_id,ol_o_id,ol_number

history.sql: SELECT h_c_w_id,h_c_d_id,h_c_id,h_w_id,h_d_id,h_amount,h_data FROM history WHERE h_d_id=7 ORDER BY h_c_w_id,h_c_d_id,h_c_id,h_w_id,h_d_id,h_amount,h_data
